column1: # Provenance caveats no check can see, for tools/provenance-inventory.sh and verify-signatures.sh.
# A caveat never changes a source's assurance class and is never counted as one.
# verify-signatures.sh --strict accepts a no-usable-key source but fails a note whose key is held.
# Columns are whitespace separated; the note runs to the end of the line.
#   package   the source name, as in tools/fetch-sources.sh and sources.lock
#   kind      recipe-transformation  the recipe changes upstream files that end up in what ships
#             undesignated-signer    the signature verifies, but upstream names no authorised signer
#             no-usable-key          the signing key is unusable: no route to it, or retired
#   location  one token: a path and the function in it, or the URL consulted
#   note      what was found and what would remove it; for no-usable-key, the routes tried and when
# A note for a package not in the manifest is refused. Add a kind only with a row that needs it.
# package  kind                   location                                note

expat      undesignated-signer    https://libexpat.github.io/             The release signature verifies against primary key 3176EF7DB2367F1FCA4F306B1F9B0E909AF37285, which gentoo.org's Web Key Directory publishes over HTTPS for sping@gentoo.org - a route that does not depend on the signature, so this is NOT circular trust. What is missing is upstream's own statement: libexpat designates no release signer and publishes no fingerprint on its site, in SECURITY.md, or in its release notes. Verified absent on 2026-09-11.

linux-firmware  recipe-transformation  build/recipes/firmware.sh:s_firmware  The files build/config/firmware.list selects are stored zstd-compressed under /lib/firmware and the kernel decompresses them on load, so the bytes on the verified root are not the tarball's bytes (their decompressed content is). Shipping them uncompressed would remove this.

libnl      undesignated-signer    https://github.com/thom311/libnl/releases  The release tarball carries a detached .sig that verifies against 67DA3FAEBAE276BA58FC6CE314F18A98993AECD5, but libnl publishes no statement of who signs its releases: not on the release page, not in the repository, and the key is in no Web Key Directory. Checked 2026-09-19. A published fingerprint from upstream would remove this.

elfutils  no-usable-key  https://sourceware.org/pub/elfutils/  The release tarball carries a detached .sig made by 6C2B631563B8D330578D3CB474FD3FA2779E7073 (Aaron Merey), and no route to that key was found: it is not in kernel.org's pgpkeys, redhat.com's Web Key Directory has nothing for amerey@redhat.com, and sourceware.org/elfutils states no fingerprint. Checked 2026-09-27. A fingerprint published by upstream would make it usable. Checked again 2026-10-16: 0.196 (2026-08-14) is signed by the same key, sourceware.org/pub/elfutils/ serves only Mark Wielaard's key (EC3CFE88F6CA0788774F5C1D1AA44BE649DE760A), and github.com/amerey publishes none.

file  no-usable-key  https://astron.com/pub/file/  The release tarball carries a detached .asc made by Christos Zoulas's DSA-1024 key BE04995BA8F90ED0C0C176C471112AB16CB33B3A, and no route to that key was found: it is not in kernel.org's pgpkeys, neither netbsd.org nor zoulas.com serves it from a Web Key Directory, and neither darwinsys.com/file nor astron.com states a fingerprint. Checked 2026-09-27. A fingerprint published by upstream would make it usable. Checked again 2026-10-16: 5.48 (2026-06-07) is signed by the same key with SHA-1, file's README names only a placeholder key id on a keyserver, github.com/zoulasc publishes no key, and neither astron.com nor netbsd.org serves one from a Web Key Directory.

flex  no-usable-key  https://github.com/westes/flex/releases  The release tarball carries a detached .sig made by 56C67868E93390AA1039AD1CE4B29C8D64885307 (Will Estes), and no route to that key was found: it is not in kernel.org's pgpkeys, it is not among the keys GitHub publishes for westes, who published v2.6.4, and neither the repository nor the release page states a fingerprint. Checked 2026-09-27. A fingerprint published by upstream would make it usable. Checked again 2026-10-16: no release since 2.6.4, and github.com/westes still publishes no key.

libevdev  no-usable-key  https://www.freedesktop.org/software/libevdev/  The release tarball carries a detached .sig made by E23B7E70B467F0BF, Peter Hutterer's key 3C2C43D9447D5938EF4551EBE23B7E70B467F0BF, and no route to that key was found: it is not in kernel.org's pgpkeys, who-t.net's Web Key Directory has nothing for it, and it is not among the keys gitlab.freedesktop.org publishes for whot; freedesktop.org's wiki did not answer an automated read. Checked 2026-09-27. A fingerprint published by upstream would make it usable. Checked again 2026-10-16: github.com/whot.gpg serves this key whole, but libevdev's releases are not published on GitHub, so that account is not the one that published the release; gitlab.freedesktop.org/whot.gpg is empty.

libmnl  no-usable-key  https://www.netfilter.org/about.html  1.0.5 is signed only by 37D964ACC04981C75500FB9BD55D978A8A1420E4, a key netfilter retired and revoked, as about.html says, and no libmnl release is signed with the current key 8C5F7146A1757A65E2422A94D70D1A666ACF2B21. Pinning the old key would turn the check into a revoked-key failure. Checked 2026-09-27. A release signed with the current key would remove this. Checked again 2026-10-16: no release newer than 1.0.5 at ftp.netfilter.org/pub/libmnl/.

wpa-supplicant  no-usable-key  https://w1.fi/wpa_supplicant/  The release tarball carries a detached .asc made by EC4AA0A991A5F2464582D52D2B6EF432EFC895FA (Jouni Malinen), and no route to that key was found: it is not in kernel.org's pgpkeys, w1.fi's Web Key Directory has nothing for j@w1.fi, and w1.fi states no fingerprint, so it designates no signer either. Checked 2026-09-27. A fingerprint published by upstream would make it usable. Checked again 2026-10-16: release announcements, v2.12's on the hostap list (2026-08) among them, end with the short id EFC895FA alone, which names no key.

wayland  undesignated-signer  https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/wayland/wayland/-/blob/main/releasing.txt  The release tarball carries a detached .sig that verifies against 34FF9526CFEF0E97A340E2E40FDE7BE0E88F5E48, which emersion.fr's Web Key Directory serves for Simon Ser, but wayland names no release signer: releasing.txt has whoever makes the release sign it with their own key (release.sh runs gpg --detach-sig). Checked 2026-09-27. A signer named by upstream would remove this.

wayland-protocols  undesignated-signer  https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/wayland/wayland-protocols  The release tarball carries a detached .sig that verifies against 34FF9526CFEF0E97A340E2E40FDE7BE0E88F5E48, which emersion.fr's Web Key Directory serves for Simon Ser, but wayland-protocols names no release signer in its README.md or GOVERNANCE.md. Checked 2026-09-27. A signer named by upstream would remove this.

wlroots  undesignated-signer  https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/wlroots/wlroots/-/blob/master/release.sh  The release tarball carries a detached .sig that verifies against 34FF9526CFEF0E97A340E2E40FDE7BE0E88F5E48, which emersion.fr's Web Key Directory serves for Simon Ser, but wlroots names no release signer: release.sh signs with the key of whoever runs it, and the README names nobody. Checked 2026-09-27. A signer named by upstream would remove this.

libdrm  undesignated-signer  https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/drm/-/blob/main/RELEASING  The release tarball carries a detached .sig that verifies against 34FF9526CFEF0E97A340E2E40FDE7BE0E88F5E48, which emersion.fr's Web Key Directory serves for Simon Ser, but libdrm names no release signer: its RELEASING says there is no designated release engineer or maintainer. Checked 2026-09-27. A signer named by upstream would remove this.

meson  undesignated-signer  https://github.com/mesonbuild/meson/releases  The release tarball carries a detached .asc that verifies against 19E2D6D9B46D8DAA6288F877C24E631BABB1FE70, the key GitHub publishes for jpakkane, who published 1.12.0, but meson names no release signer: neither its README nor docs/markdown/Release-procedure.md mentions signing. Checked 2026-09-27. A signer named by upstream would remove this.

pixman  undesignated-signer  https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/pixman/pixman/-/blob/master/RELEASING  The release's .sha512 carries a detached .asc that verifies against a subkey of 3BB639E56F861FA2E86505690FDD682D974CA72A, which gentoo.org's Web Key Directory serves for Matt Turner, but pixman names no release signer: its RELEASING has whoever makes the release sign with GPGKEY=<your gpg key id>. Checked 2026-09-27. A signer named by upstream would remove this.
